digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review-bot credential management and webhook auth
propositions: The review-bot currently sources the Gerrit token from the URL query parameter ?token= and logs it in plaintext in uvicorn access logs, exposing the credential.
A code fix (66af / Gerrit 1384) that moves token sourcing to the X-Rebar-Token header and adds log redaction has been merged to main but not yet deployed to the production container.
Rotating the token before deploying the 66af fix would cause the new token to be immediately re-leaked when the next webhook call arrives.

The GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret used simultaneously for bot outbound HTTP basic-auth, inbound webhook authentication, and container environment configuration, requiring atomic rotation via service-user.sh to keep all three synchronized.

The correct rotation sequence requires deploying 66af first, then rotating the token via service-user.sh, restarting the container, and verifying both inbound webhook and outbound LLM-Review vote success.
